# atlassian_organization_group_membership (Resource)

Manages a user's membership in an Atlassian organization group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_organization_users" "example" {
  organization_id = "your-organization-id"
  directory_id    = "your-directory-id"
  emails          = ["user@example.com"]
}

resource "atlassian_organization_group_membership" "example" {
  organization_id = "your-organization-id"
  directory_id    = "your-directory-id"
  group_id        = "your-group-id"
  account_id      = one(data.atlassian_organization_users.example.users).account_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Atlassian account ID of the group member.
- `directory_id` (String) Directory ID containing both the user and group.
- `group_id` (String) Atlassian organization group ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Atlassian organization ID used in the Organization API path.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite group membership identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = atlassian_organization_group_membership.example

  identity = {
    organization_id = "your-organization-id"
    directory_id    = "your-directory-id"
    group_id        = "your-group-id"
    account_id      = "your-account-id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `account_id` (String) Atlassian account ID of the group member.
- `directory_id` (String) Directory ID containing both the user and group.
- `group_id` (String) Atlassian organization group ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Atlassian organization ID used in the Organization API path.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = atlassian_organization_group_membership.example
  id = "organization-id,directory-id,group-id,account-id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import atlassian_organization_group_membership.example 'organization-id,directory-id,group-id,account-id'
```
